(18) The Creation Date Is in the OpenAPI Description 

# GitHub OpenAPI description (excerpt)
paths:
  /users/{username}:
    get:
      operationId: users/get-by-username
      summary: Get a user
      responses:
        "200":
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                oneOf:
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/private-user"
                  - $ref: "#/components/schemas/public-user"
components:
  schemas:
    public-user:
      required: [login, id, ..., created_at, ...]
      properties:
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
  • github-openapi-get-user.yaml

(19) The MCP Tool Does Not Return It, and Does Not Say So 

# MCP tool definition (from tools/list, trimmed, shown as YAML)
name: search_users
description: >-
  Find GitHub users by username, real name, or other profile information.
  Useful for locating developers, contributors, or team members.
inputSchema:
  type: object
  properties:
    query:
      type: string
      description: >-
        User search query. Examples: 'john smith', 'location:seattle',
        'followers:>100'. Search is automatically scoped to type:user.
    sort:
      type: string
      description: >-
        Sort users by number of followers or repositories, or when the
        person joined GitHub.
      enum: [followers, repositories, joined]
  required: [query]
  • github-mcp-search-users.yaml
